standard_prerequisites.name: The Tutte-violation relation for a set U and the notion of a minimal set satisfying it
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stated by the author immediately before the counted lemma (the display labelled eq:tutte-violation at source line 660, delivered verbatim as a context span of this card)
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the property that the minimal set U has more components in G_p - U than its own size, which the proof uses to count components after deleting a vertex.

core_obligations: Assume the contrary: take a minimal set U of size u satisfying the Tutte-violation relation, with more than u components in G_p - U and a vertex v whose neighbourhood in G meets at most two of those components (proof line 707).

Delete the vertex: for U' = U minus v the count of components of G_p - U' is at least one more than u - 1, because v meets at most two components of G_p - U and therefore at most one component disappears (proof lines 709).
Contradiction with minimality: U' then also satisfies the violation relation while being strictly smaller than U, contradicting the minimality of U, which proves the claim (proof line 709).
proof_roadmap: 反设存在最小违反集 U 与一个只与 G_p - U 的至多两个连通分量相邻的顶点 v。
去掉 v 得到更小的 U'：分量数至少是 u（> u-1 = |U'|），于是 U' 也违反，和 U 的最小性矛盾。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a structural lemma on minimal Tutte obstructions (author lemma at source lines 703-705, label lem:three_edges): every vertex of a minimal set U satisfying the Tutte-violation relation has neighbours in at least three components of G_p - U. The proof (source lines 706-710) is short but is a complete minimality argument: it deletes the offending vertex from the obstruction and shows that at most one component of the graph minus the smaller set disappears, so the violation count survives the deletion (proof line 709). The whole content is that counting step, and the lemma is one of the two structural inputs used later to control the size of the set A in the Gallai-Edmonds decomposition. H2.
